address: Fleischmarkt 20, 1010 Wien, Austria
review:
We enjoyed our stay at Hotel Austria very much! The standard room with the en suite bathroom was a good size for two people and two suitcases. We enjoyed the Klimt art on the walls and slept well. The decor is very traditional for Vienna throughout the hotel and was exactly what we expected. I can’t believe how quiet the rooms were in such a central location.

The AC unit worked great in the heat. It's a wall mounted unit controlled by remote the quickly and quietly gets the room cooled and the air is pointed straight at the bed.

Breakfast was amazing! Breads varied day to day and there were even cooked veggies on the buffet. The giant coffee machine makes all drinks you'd want too.

We walked pretty much everywhere to all the museums and restaurants. It was great to have an elevator in the hotel after all those steps.

Staff are super friendly and helpful. They recommended good restaurants nearby and helped with an early morning checkout with a breakfast to go and taxi reservation.

I'd 100% stay here again when in Vienna.

address: 5 Watson Rd, Preston, CT 06365
review:
My husband and I spent more than $500 for a night in the king-size suite with the whirl pool tub for our anniversary. The facilities themselves are so worn down, there's chips all over the old wooden furniture. The whirl pool is a nice size, but the water doesn't get hot enough to really even enjoy it. The bed is lumpy and hard with scratchy, thin hospital blankets on it. The only good thing about this place is its proximity to the casino, but there's no shuttle, so be prepared to wait 15 mins for an Uber for a 5 minute drive.
We got in late from the casino, and the night manager knocked on our door for a noise complaint. We apologized and promised to be quieter. About 10 mins later, she knocked on my door again, saying we're being too noisy. I asked what exactly the noise was since my husband was relaxing in the bath, and I was in the bedroom microwaving a pizza. We hadn't been playing music, we hadn't been shouting, the TV wasn't even on, I was genuinely confused about what the complaint was. She said that she could hear our voices from down the hallway, which was odd since we weren't even talking to each other. She said that she would normally ask a guest to leave at this point but that she was gonna give us one more chance. I apologized again just to defuse the situation because I knew we were getting ready to go to bed anyway. But to be threatened to be put out for supposedly talking too loud while you're literally standing in silence watching your pizza microwave is kind of ridiculous.
TLDR: paid over $500 for a leaky lukewarm bath, a rock-hard hospital bed, and to be reprimanded like a child at a sleepover for talking in my bedroom.
response_of_owner: Hi Xiomara, thank you for choosing to celebrate your anniversary with us. We're truly sorry to hear about the issues you encountered during your stay. We are looking into the concerns you raised about the room's condition and the interaction with our night manager. Your experience is important to us, and we want to ensure it is addressed appropriately. Please contact https://help.hilton.com/s/contactsupport and (860) 885-1000 to provide more details about your booking and discuss your experience further. We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a better experience in the future.

review: We are currently checked into this hotel. While not one thing here is amazing, different, or perfect, everything as a whole is great. This hotel gives you 200 dollar a night customer service, and 60 dollar a night rooms. That's a great trade off. From the 200 dollar a night rooms, with 35 dollar fleabag hotel customer service. So, of you're truly an unbiased, expect the expected, this place fulfills 100 percent. review:
During my stay, I found the staff to be truly outstanding. Their exceptional service and genuine efforts to go above and beyond were the highlights of the experience.

However, the accommodations appeared somewhat outdated and would benefit from some attention and refurbishment to meet the high standards typically associated with the Banyan Tree brand.

Additionally, I would like to note that the hotel shares its restaurant with the neighboring property, which resulted in a somewhat busy and understaffed environment. As a result, there were extended waiting times for meals, and it occasionally seemed that non-resident guests were prioritised.

Having experienced multiple Banyan Tree resorts, this particular property fell short of the exceptional standards I’ve come to expect. Nonetheless, the dedication and warmth of the staff made the stay significantly more enjoyable and memorable.

I will definitely recommend this location to family & friends and will choose this location for all my future stays. Kuddos to the amazing staff.

Wir waren  Mitte September und  für uns war es ein sehr großer Campingplatz. Brötchen holen sind da schon mal 20 Minuten. Viele hatten Fahrräder. Der Platz ist schön gelegen am Woblitzsee. In der Hauptsaison sicher voll .Waldseilgarten u.v. mehr. Die sanitären Anlagen für Camper haben uns beeindruckt, sowas von sauber und gross es gab Kinderbäder, Familienbäder, Geschirrspüler usw..

Nach Wesenberg sind es ca 8 km da kann man beim Netto einen größeren Einkauf erledigen, für den kleinen Einkauf und Brötchen haben wir den Einkaufsladen auf den Platz genutzt.
Wir haben unsere Unterkunft als Startpunkt für Ausflüge zb  Waren an der Mürritz oder zum Zierker See usw genutzt.

Da wir schon lange keinen Campingplatz mehr hatten wo man in der Mittagspause nicht rausfahren oder reinfahren konnte und der so groß ist war es ungewohnt für uns. Klar man hätte ja vorher das Auto vielleicht bei der Rezeption parken können und dann die 25 Minuten zum Haus laufen können.
Bei den kleinen Campingplätzen war auch ein  Parkplatz direkt bei der Ausfahrt  wie zb auf Rügen doch da hatten wir dann keine 5 Minuten zum Ferienhaus zu laufen.

Eine kleine Anmerkung die Vorhänge an den Fenstern sahen schön aus, haben aber nicht abgedunkelt. Für Langschläfer vielleicht etwas störend.

review:
Piszę opinię żeby przestrzec innych, gdyż ja zignorowałam negatywne opinie i sugerowałam się tylko pozytywnymi.
Byłam w wielu krajach i hotelach, a pobyt w tym miejscu zaliczam do najgorszych.
Hotel na pewno nie zasługuje na 4*. Jest to hotel na poziomie 2-3*.
W naszym pokoju na zasłonach widoczna była pleśń, w łazience płytki brudne i widoczne stare owady. W łazience również dziura na suficie z której kapała woda. Klimatyzacja prawie nie działała. WiFi działa odrobinę tylko w pokojach.
W wielu miejscach na terenie hotelu czuć brzydki zapach, a w wielu miejscach leżały pety i słomki.
Chlor w basenach prawie nie wyczuwalny, więc nie wiem jak dezynfekowana jest woda. Basenik dla dzieci brudny, zjeżdżalnie zniszczone. O leżakach i materacach na nich nie chcę wspominać..
Jedzienie praktycznie jest codziennie takie samo i niezbyt smaczne. Do tego dwa razy znalazłam włosy w jedzeniu. Kilka razy jedliśmy na mieście i było świetne. Kawa również tylko na mieście.
Plaża jest niesamowicie brudna, wszędzie leżą śmieci i tak wygląda całe miasto.
Negatywne opinie nie są przesadzone.
Nie jestem wymagająca, ale czystość to podstawa.
Na masażach kobiety nie wymieniły ręczników co było dość obrzydliwe.
Jeśli chcecie się dobrze pobawić to jest hotelowy bar Zanzibar, ale nie dajcie się namówić na wyjście poza hotel, obsługa jest dość natarczywa.

Z pozytywów to jest kilka osób, które naprawdę się starają, kilka kelnerów i animatorów.

Jeśli chcesz poczuć ten klimat, ale z większą kulturą i czystością to polecam poszukać coś w Egipcie. Jeśli chcesz zostać w Europie to Chorwacja jest cudowna.

Wycieczki lepiej wytargować na mieście.

Ogólnie wielkie rozczarowanie i niesmak, nigdy tak się nie cieszyłam na powrót do domu. Gdyby nie wyjazd większą grupą to było by naprawdę smutno.
Nie polecam.

review:
I’m giving this hotel a 2.5 to 3-star rating based on my recent experience during our first visit to Chicago. We were excited to stay here after seeing the beautiful pictures on the website, and as a rewards member, I had high expectations.
Upon entering our first room, I immediately noticed a red stain on the lamp that made me very uneasy. I couldn’t tell if it was spilled liquid, blood, or something else entirely, which made me anxious. I called the front desk, and they suggested it might just be the lamp’s pattern. However, I work in property management, and I can assure you that it was definitely not just a pattern. The staff didn’t seem too concerned about the stain and mentioned it could be from a prior guest’s drink. Regardless, it should have been properly cleaned and checked before our arrival, and the lack of attention to this detail was disappointing.
After that, I was moved to another room, which was better overall. However, I found that the first set of towels had light yellow/brown stains on all of them. I had to request a swap, and they only provided two clean towels in return. It’s hard to believe that multiple towels could go unnoticed or not cleaned properly after the last guest.
I also noticed some rust on the door fixtures, which further detracted from the overall experience.
On a positive note, I did enjoy my stay overall. The hotel has a very vlog-worthy atmosphere and is pleasing to the eye. I loved the jacuzzi, although I wish it had been hotter!
Thank you for allowing me to enjoy my first visit to this hotel. I hope these issues can be addressed for future guests, as they would greatly enhance the experience.

review: Just returned home after a 3 night stay at this hotel. The hotel is very small, the bedroom was tiny, nothing like the large spacious rooms you see advertised. I did ask at reception to check if our room was superior, was told yes, as some of non superior rooms don't even have windows. The cupboard to hang clothes in is high up and has a pole to bring the hanger bar down, had 7 coat hangers. There is an iron, ironing board, mini fridge and hairdryer. The hotel is ultra modern though and very clean. Many quirky features, including the smart lighting, key fobs, and heating. We didn't use the small wellness sauna, which is downstairs next to the dining area. Breakfast was very average and staff not the friendliest. The hotel is facing a children's play area, we were quite shocked to see a group of four adults who looked either homeless or substance users, openly urinating at the end of the play area, they had cans of beer and bottles of vodka, intimidating to walk past. The hotel is about a 25 minute straight walk down to where the centre of Budapest is (Ferris wheel, shopping area) there is a bus stop right outside hotel and metro is also near. It cost about £5 in a taxi to New York cafe and Szechenyi baths, albeit you could walk, again about a 25 minute walk. We could leave our cases on the day of checkout, checkout is 11am. The nicest of reception staff, was the blonde female member,  who checked us in and out. Towels were changed daily, but wasn't impressed that cleaning staff left our room open on one day, I did mention to reception who apologised for the security breach.

place_name: Aspire Beauty and Aesthetics - Laser Hair Removal, Heston
address: 18 Hogarth Gardens, Heston, Hounslow TW5 0QS, United Kingdom
review:
I genuinely wish people who wrote reviews were honest about their experience. Their honesty can help others and avoid disappointment.

I found this establishment on Treatwell and based on the 5 star reviews I booked myself in for a deep cleansing facial which cost £60. I didn't however book the treatment via Treatwell, I called the owner directly to make an appointment. She told me not to book it on Treatwell since we were already chatting on the phone. She only accepts cash. Prior to the appt, I went to the atm machine which wasn't working so I asked her if I can do a bank transfer and she said no. I ran around for 20 mins trying to find a cash point.

Anyway  I arrived at her house and her mum answered the door. There's a side entrance which I wasn't aware of since it was my first time going there. Her room is in the garden and when I walked in, I was shocked. It didn't look like the room as pictured on Treatwell. I've attached the picture on Treatwell to this review. There were boxes everywhere and the room looked a mess. The actual facial room was tiny. There was no ambience.

She started with a cleanser which she said was for combination skin, when I told her I had sensitive skin she said it was for all skin types 😀 Then came the sales pitch... this carried on throughout the facial, she was trying to sell me products/brands, brands that celebrities use. She asked me if I wanted to add on anything additional to the facial, I could pay the difference via bank transfer!!!! When I asked her if I could do a bank transfer initially she said no but when it meant more money for her, it was suddenly possibly. I understand that small businesses need to make money but a facial is supposed to be a relaxing experience (this was not) and there is a time and place to sell products. She wasn't present in the moment and was on her phone texting while I had my mask on. The relaxing music she had on her phone was interrupted by her texting.

Anyway the facial was as follows: cleanse which took less than 5 mins, toner which was a spray, steam, extraction, face mask, eye patches. Not sure how this dragged out to an hour. She barely touched my face! Definitely not worth the price! I wouldn't have paid more than £30 for this facial. Now I know why I don't get my facials done in Hounslow. Won't be going back. It was very strange, when I was grabbing my things and putting on my shoes to leave, she was standing extremely close to me. So bizarre!

I can't write this review on Treatwell because I didn't book the facial through them but I hope people see this review and take it on board.

review:
Hotelpreise in und um LA sind immer hoch. Die Lage des Hotels passt, um das Hotel selbst gibt es einge Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und kleine Restaurants. 



Leider ist das Hotel stark in die Jahre gekommen. Die Zimmerausstattung ist abgewohnt, die Zimmer sind dunkel einerichtet. Bei uns hat, ohne Grund, der Couchtisch gefehlt. Die Betten waren OK; aber leider haben wir Haare gefunden, auch im Bad. Das Frühstück, bei uns inkl., war maximal durchschnittlich. Die Speisen schmeckten fade, der Service war aber gut. Der Pool wurde anschainend auch von externen genutzt, von den 3 Fahrstühlen war immer mindestens einer kaputt. Roomservice nur am Abreisetag.



Wer dieses Hotel als Ausgangspunkt für einen LA Besuch wählt, sei gewarnt. Auf Grund des katastrophalen Autoverkehrs in und um LA herum braucht man auch für kurze Strecken viel länger, als gedacht. Wem das und die alte Ausstattung egalt ist, und mit Abstrichen in der Sauberkeit leben kann, ist hier gut aufgehoben
